{"id":1850108197,"question_id":4150,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"7 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1765195095,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"139 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1850108197/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Sort Integers by Binary Reflection","memory":"59.3 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    static long long reflection(int x)\n    {\n        if(x == 0) return 0;\n        string ans = \"\";\n        while(x > 0)\n        {\n            ans.push_back((x % 2) + '0');\n            x /= 2;\n        }\n        int i = 0;\n        long long num = 0;\n\n        while(ans[i] == '0') i++;\n        ans = ans.substr(i);\n        if(ans.empty()) ans = \"0\";\n        \n        for(char ch : ans)\n        {\n            num = num * 2 + (ch - '0');\n        }\n        return num;\n    }\n    \n    static bool mycomp(int a , int b){\n        long long ra = reflection(a);\n        long long rb = reflection(b);\n\n        if(ra == rb) return a < b;\n        else return ra < rb;\n    }\n    vector<int> sortByReflection(vector<int>& nums) {\n        sort(nums.begin() , nums.end() , mycomp);\n        return nums;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"sort-integers-by-binary-reflection","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1275}
